ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Stories & Scenarios
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Starting scenarios and story events for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Six scenarios (Lone survivor, Flight from the sect, Destroyed family, Ascension Project, Classical era, Beast hunters), plus four more with Convergence: Factions (Lost disciples, Exiled alchemist, Healers of the infirmary, Dragon heir); each with a story that calls back later (the assassin of your sect, the clan that returns, the master who mends your dantian...). Story events after the Convergence: cultists fleeing the Calamity, ferocious beasts, a plea for help from an allied sect, the vengeance of a clan, a treasure being born. With Odyssey: dragon vein and ancient sect ruins landmarks.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation. Better with Convergence: Factions (the sects of Jiuxiao and their honorary titles), Fauna and Flora (spirit beasts) and Apparel.
